info.title: Copilot Studio Bots
info.description: Complete coverage of the Power Platform API Bots operations for Microsoft Copilot Studio. Manage maker evaluation test sets and runs, download evaluation snapshots, quarantine and release agents, control the admin connector consent bypass, reassign agent ownership, and delete agents. Includes MCP support for Copilot Studio agents.

post.description: Trigger an asynchronous evaluation run for a test set against the agent. Returns a run ID to track progress and retrieve results. By default, evaluates the draft (unpublished) version of the agent.

parameters.description: API version.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Evaluation run configuration.

mcsConnectionId.description: The Copilot Studio connection ID for authenticated evaluation. If empty, the evaluation runs anonymously without access to authenticated tools or knowledge sources.

RunOnPublishedBot.description: When true, evaluates the published version of the agent. Defaults to false (evaluates draft version).

EvaluationRunName.description: Optional name for this evaluation run. Useful for identifying runs in dashboards and reports.

404.description: Agent or test set not found.

422.description: Another evaluation run is already in progress for this agent. Only one run at a time is allowed.

ConnectorConsentBypassResponse.description: The admin connector consent bypass setting for a Copilot Studio agent.

adminConsentBypass.description: Set to true to suppress the end user connection consent prompt for this agent, or false to require consent.

ReassignBotRequestBody.description: Request body for reassigning the owner of a Copilot Studio agent.

AgentSummary.description: A Copilot Studio agent with its harness and sharing posture.

environmentIsManaged.description: Whether the environment is a Managed Environment.

lastPublishedAt.description: When the agent was last published. Empty means never published.

isQuarantined.description: Whether the agent is currently quarantined.

isCLIAgent.description: Harness indicator: 'true' for the GitHub Copilot harness, 'false' for Standard or Copilot Chat, 'unknown' when the platform did not report it. Compare as a string, never as a boolean, and never treat 'unknown' as 'false'. Undocumented property that may change without notice.

harness.description: Readable harness label derived from isCLIAgent. 'false' cannot separate Standard from Copilot Chat, so both report as 'Standard or Copilot Chat'.

sharedWithViewersUserCount.description: Number of users the agent is shared with as viewers.

sharedWithViewersEntireTenant.description: Whether the agent is shared with the entire tenant.

sharedWithEditorsUserCount.description: Number of users who can edit the agent.

channels.description: Channels the agent is published to.

AgentInventoryResponse.description: Agent inventory for an environment or the whole tenant.

truncated.description: True when the page ceiling was reached and agents are missing. Scope to an environment if this is true.

environmentId.description: Environment scanned, or empty for the whole tenant.
